text: {"reply":"Thank you, Ms. King. I checked RO-116831. The invoice shows one estimate line of $2,971.61 CAD. The total is $3,357.92 CAD with taxes, and it is marked paid. I don't see an $844 charge or a curb-damage line, so your bill and our record don't match. I can't decide a warranty claim or a refund. I'm passing this to a person, who will review the invoice, the technician's finding and your concern that the rims should not have bent. If you want a second inspection of the rims, a person can arrange it.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer King, verified with RO-116831, disputes an $844 charge for curb damage to the rims. She says it is a defect and wants a warranty refund. The invoice shows a single estimate line and a total of $3,357.92 CAD, status paid. It has no $844 line and no curb-damage line, so the customer's figure conflicts with the record. Needs service manager review of the billing dispute and the warranty desk's view. A documented second inspection may be wanted. No coverage or refund was promised.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P05","P06","P10","P12","P14"]}
